verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change correctly replaces groom's private case-sensitive `Retry-After` lookup with the existing shared case-insensitive header reader while retaining the shared strict numeric parser. The new tests cover lowercase mappings, `.items()`-only objects, unreadable objects, exception rendering, delegation identity, the exact requested field name, and the dependency's own self-test. The production call remains bounded to idempotent transient retries, missing or unreadable headers still fall back to the existing backoff, and the checkout dependency fails loudly if absent. I found no correctness, soundness, test-vacuity, or security issue in the diff.
